proposal.label: needs more info
proposal.comment: Could you provide a complete minimal repro project that we can build and run on Windows? Please include: the full source file (with `#include` and `main`), the exact compiler/Visual Studio and version, the precise compile/link commands or the Visual Studio project settings, and whether you used the official `duckdb.dll` from the 1.0.0 release or a build from source. Also attach the full exception call stack or crash log produced by the debugger. These details are needed to reproduce an access violation on Windows.
proposal.rationale: The report includes the C++ snippet and OS/version but omits how DuckDB was built/linked and exact build/run commands. Access violations on Windows often depend on linking mode (DLL vs static), runtime library mismatches, or build flags; without the full source, compile/link commands, and which DLL was used, the crash cannot be reproduced.
